metadata.title: Synthetic broadband landscape
metadata.sourceState: sourceCommit is the analysis starting commit; input/output hashes identify the exact executed run.
metadata.reuse: Repository owner explicitly authorized reuse for this application on 2026-11-02. Upstream has no general license file; this permission is not a general upstream license.
metadata.coordinateSystem: Local equirectangular, origin (-119.25, 37.25), sphere radius 6371008.8 m; x=R*(lon-lon0)*cos(lat0), y=R*(lat-lat0), angles in radians.
metadata.sourceUnits: Synthetic EPSG:4326 grid degrees; exported approximate metres. Not census boundaries.

definitions.adoption: Synthetic broadband subscription rate, fraction [0,1]. Not infrastructure availability.
definitions.income: Synthetic median household income, USD, no measured vintage.
definitions.households: Upstream population column used as a household proxy. These are not measured household estimates.
definitions.underserved: Entire population proxy of tracts with broadband_rate < 0.65; otherwise zero. Not population * (1 - rate).
definitions.countyType: Synthetic urban_proximity > 0.62: urban; > 0.35: suburban; otherwise rural.

lisa.correction: Benjamini-Yekutieli across 400 two-sided local pseudo p-values
lisa.seedNote: Generator and spatial permutation seed 42. Rook sensitivity is in the analytical run summary. Displayed local p-values are BY-adjusted.
